name: TRUTH — Every-3-Day SQL Snapshot
description: Every 3 days at 6AM UTC: exports core tables as JSON + all function/trigger/view definitions as .sql to Drive. 3-day cadence = dark agent rollback window. Anti-hollow gates on both files. Logs to audit_log + updates last_sql_backup.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session_date: $now.toISODate(), session_title: "Every-3-Day SQL Snapshot + Schema Export", engine: "n8n-automated", notes: "Snapshot + schema definitions pushed to Drive study folder. Counts: sights=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.sights + " tensions=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.tensions + " journal=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.journal + " guards=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.drift_guards + " operational_doc=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.operational_doc + " origin_log=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.origin_log + " schema_chars=" + $("Build SQL Snapshot").first().json.counts.schema_chars }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ p_date: $('Build SQL Snapshot').first().json.snapshot_date, p_counts: $('Build SQL Snapshot').first().json.counts }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch schema definitions
nodes.notes: Calls RPC export_schema_definitions() — returns all public functions, triggers, views as SQL text.

nodes.name: Fetch live counts
nodes.notes: Live row counts for the seven tables this snapshot walks, read BEFORE the fetches so the anti-hollow gate can compare CAPTURED against LIVE instead of against zero. Rows added mid-run make captured >= live and still pass; only a genuine shortfall fails.

activeVersion.name: Back up the four procedure manuals
activeVersion.description: Adds session_load_manual, book_walk_manual, oracle_manual and fold_manual (all versions) to the snapshot as a third file, TRUTH_Procedure_Manuals_<date>.json, with the captured-against-live anti-hollow gate (snapshot_live_counts now carries the four keys). Existing nodes and the Build SQL Snapshot code are unchanged.
